body.name: \(\mathcal B_{\mathrm{CK}}(n,m,\tau)\)
body.def: \(\mathcal B_{\mathrm{CK}}(n,m,\tau):=\ell\min\{1,[m\log(2m)/n]^{\varkappa}\}\), the familywise coordinatewise known-envelope benchmark obtained from the tail-event bias--variance method of Carpentier and Kim (2015) after translating their relative second-order parameter to the present absolute remainder exponent.
